│          alt+q quit | Esc close                                                │
│          j/k · ↑/↓ move | alt+space primary                                    │
│          alt+d done | alt+o reopen                                             │
│          alt+b block | enter open                                              │
│          →/← peek | + capture                                                  │
│          alt+e title | alt+x/Delete delete                                     │
│          alt+u undo | z drawer                                                 │
│          : palette | ? help                                                    │
│          P project                                                             │
│                                                                                │
│          any key to close                                                      │
